subtopic: 03 · Standard Values, Even-Odd Nature and Allied Angles
title: Long allied-angle products that collapse

board_content.text: $270^\circ+\theta$ is in Quadrant IV (cosine $+$); $n=3$ is odd, so $\cos\to\sin$.
Long allied-angle products almost always collapse to ±1. If yours doesn't, recheck a sign.

segments_english.text: Example five simplifies a four-term expression down to a single constant.

Reduce each piece: sine of ninety plus theta is cosine theta; cosine of one eighty minus theta is minus cosine theta; cosine of ninety minus theta is sine theta; sine of one eighty plus theta is minus sine theta.
Multiply and add: cosine times minus cosine, plus sine times minus sine, gives minus cosine squared minus sine squared, which is minus one. The whole expression collapses to a constant.
Example six is a short proof: show cosine of two seventy plus theta equals sine theta.
Two seventy plus theta sits in Quadrant four for small theta, where cosine is positive, and n equals three is odd so cosine becomes sine.
So the result is plus sine theta. Done.
Example seven is an intimidating-looking product and quotient of six reduced terms.
Reduce each term: the numerator becomes tangent squared theta while the denominator becomes minus tangent squared theta, so their ratio is simply minus one.
<excited>The lesson is worth gold:</excited> long allied-angle products almost always collapse to plus or minus one. If yours refuses to, you've dropped a sign — go back and find it.

segments_hinglish.text: Example पाँच एक four-term expression को एक single constant में simplify करता है.

हर piece reduce कीजिए: sine of ninety plus theta है cosine theta; cosine of one eighty minus theta minus cosine theta; cosine of ninety minus theta sine theta; sine of one eighty plus theta minus sine theta.
Multiply और add कीजिए: cosine times minus cosine, plus sine times minus sine, देता minus cosine squared minus sine squared, यानी minus one. पूरी expression एक constant में collapse हो जाती है.
Example छह एक short proof है: दिखाइए cosine of two seventy plus theta equals sine theta.
Two seventy plus theta छोटे theta के लिए Quadrant four में बैठता है, जहाँ cosine positive, और n equals three odd so cosine बनता है sine.
So result है plus sine theta. हो गया.
Example सात छह reduced terms का डरावना दिखने वाला product और quotient है.
हर term reduce कीजिए: numerator बनता है tangent squared theta जबकि denominator minus tangent squared theta, so इनका ratio बस minus one.
<excited>ये सबक सोने के बराबर है:</excited> long allied-angle products लगभग हमेशा plus या minus one में collapse होते हैं. अगर नहीं हो रहा, तो एक sign छूट गया, वापस जाकर ढूँढिए.
